releases.name: Vaulted Valor
releases.summary:
Trapped in an underground vault designed to protect humanity, you discover that survival comes at a cost. 

In Vaulted Valor, a narrative-driven post-apocalyptic RPG, every choice matters as you navigate a world of intrigue, sabotage, and hidden agendas. 

Will you unite the vault’s inhabitants to confront its dark truths, or will the fractures within tear it apart?

releases.name: MINERALS: Deep Core Mining
releases.summary: Mine the vast underground and collect ores and gemstones—collect! collect! collect like crazy! “MINERALS: Deep Core Mining” is an over-the-top mining game with roguelite elements. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your abilities and take on an endless underground that changes with every run!

releases.name: Quantum Hell
releases.summary: Take on the role of a journalist trapped in a ruthless quantum universe where you'll need a diverse arsenal and the manipulation of quantum physics to survive and progress. Quick thinking, speed, and precision will be essential to surviving in this retro style physics FPS

releases.name: Old Coin Pusher Gaiden
releases.summary: A new evolution of Old Coin Pusher Friends: a coin‑pusher RPG where you train your samurai, prepare Action Spheres, and explore deep caves filled with enemies, treasures, and events. Shoot Coins to earn rewards. Up to four players can battle The formidable in Raid mode.

releases.name: Storehand
releases.summary: Storehand is a cozy stocking game about tidying shelves, organizing thousands of items, and shaping your own store layout. Map custom aisles, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy a relaxing free‑placement mode as you build your perfect shop.

releases.name: Teddy's Horde
releases.summary: A top-down arena survival brawler. Pick a bear, drop into the arena, and hold out against escalating waves of wardens. Alone or with your friends in local coop.

releases.name: AquaDesk
releases.summary: AquaDesk is a relaxing aquarium simulation that turns your desktop into a living home for tropical fish. Feed, care for, breed, and discover unique fish through genetics and unlock new features as your calm desktop aquarium grows.

releases.name: Tidy Mart
releases.summary: Tidy Mart is a cozy organizing game where you arrange hundreds of products across different stores, from a small corner shop to a sprawling supermarket. No time limits. No rushing customers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

releases.name: Renz Village Adventure
releases.summary: Manage a growing fantasy village where heroes fight monsters, explore dungeons, level up, and bring home treasure to expand your town.

releases.name: Da Bomb!
releases.summary: Discover the revival of Minesweeper. Da Bomb! twists the classic concept into an explosive 3D puzzle. Clear the grid across the surface of a cube, and test your reflexes in the innovative and addictive Time Attack mode. Every second counts!

releases.name: G.O.D. Global Orbital Defense
releases.summary: Take control of the G.O.D. system, the U.P.A.’s tactical satellite. Orbiting in silence above Vel’Aris, your mission is to protect the planet from every threat. Manage orbital fire. But remember: G.O.D. sees everything... even what you wish remained buried.

releases.name: Alien Bloom
releases.summary: Battle for control of the planet in this multiplayer strategy card game.

releases.name: A Short & Simple Pixel Love Story
releases.summary: This linear visual novel tells the story of protagonist Lance, a 25-year-old male, who is dating in these modern times.

releases.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
Escape War
releases.summary: You are the last person to evacuate a city that is being bombed. Survive and escape.

releases.name: Frost-Buried Truth
releases.summary: 《Epidemic Prevention:Secret Agency》 is a hardcore first-person stealth survival horror based on brutal true events. Trapped as a test subject in the Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department, you must evade relentless pursuit. Hide in the shadows, hold your breath, and escape alive!

releases.name: S.O.L School Of Labyrinth
releases.summary: A dungeon crawl RPG set in an otherworldly realm beneath an old school building. Explore again and again, restore your base, and find your way back to everyday life.

releases.name: Sky Scramble
releases.summary: Local multiplayer air combat across three eras of aviation history. Fight gravity and your friends. Bail out, parachute down, pull out your pistol, and make it personal. Up to 4 players.

releases.name: Cylindrika
releases.summary: Fast paced, free flowing, geometry based 3D arcade style movement shooter. Dash, jump, and slide around to traverse a unique world shape. Manipulate physics to your advantage. Positioning and speed are key. Deterministic enemies require deliberate combat decisions.
